verdict.rationale: Autumn is described as an "open-source control layer," and its GitHub repo shows the full product, including the dashboard, running locally with `bun dev` at localhost:3000. That means the core can run on your own infrastructure, but the evidence only covers a local dev setup, not a supported production deployment. Missing for 10: production self-hosting docs (deployment, infrastructure dependencies, configuration), clarity on feature parity with the hosted service, and independent or hands-on reports of running it self-hosted.
